fnol_text: My name is Ravi Gallagher and I live at 233 Sycamore Drive, Salem, MA 01957. You can reach me on (555) 967-7770 or ravi.gallagher@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 15 November 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00108. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Gallagher on (555) 967-7770 to acknowledge the claim. Ravi confirmed the loss date as 15 November 2025.
Site visit to 233 Sycamore Drive. Neighbour Maya Gallagher was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ravi sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
